caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, shallow bowl with a decorative, ornate handle attached to its upper edge. The bowl is shaded in tones of gray, suggesting a metallic or reflective surface, and features concentric circles indicating its depth and form. The handle is intricate, with symmetrical cut-out patterns, rounded elements, and a central circular motif topped by a small round loop. The entire object fits within a rectangular border drawn on a lightly yellowed background. Below the bowl, there is a smaller rectangular box containing a simple top-view outline of the bowl with a handle, indicating its basic dimensions with arrows. At the lower right of the large rectangle, the name "Charles Cullen" is written in cursive.
title: Pewter Porringer
